<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_rel_widget_clone"><sp_rel_widget_clone action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><child display_value="Copy of Knowledge List Widget Template">818e895ec3c2e2509d5afeac05013166</child><cloned>2025-06-12 12:24:56</cloned><last_validated>2025-06-12 12:24:56</last_validated><parent display_value="Knowledge List Widget Template">1e6b5b3adb20320099f93691f0b8f5a8</parent><payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><sp_widget><category/><client_script><![CDATA[function($filter,spUtil,cabrillo,$rootScope, i18n) {
	/* widget controller */
	var c = this;
	c.isNative = cabrillo.isNative() && c.options.override_mobile;
	
	//Use KB specific stylic for all portals unless rating style is set.
	c.KBRatingStyle = c.options.kb_rating_style;

	c.getOrderedItems = function() {
		var filtered = $filter('limitTo') (c.options.result, c.options.max_records);
		return $filter('orderBy') (filtered, 'count', c.options.reverse);
	}
}]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>$kb-item-box-shadow: 1px 1px 10px 0.2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)!default;

.kb-list-item{
  border-bottom: none;
  border-top: none; 
}
small{
  font-size:93%; 
}
.secondary-info{
  color:$text-muted;
  padding-top: 3px;
}
.main_text a{
  display:block; 
}
.dot{
  padding:5px; 
}
.kb-star-on {
  text-shadow: $fav-star-outline;
}
.kb-star-off {
  color: $fav-star-color-off !important;
  text-shadow: $fav-star-outline;
}
.sp-stars{
  display: inline-flex;
  letter-spacing: .5px;
}
.kb-rating-stars{
  font-size: 12px;
  display: inline-flex;
  margin-top: -6px;

  .glyphicon{
    line-height: 0; 
  }
  .rating-stars [role="button"] {
    cursor: text;
  }
}
.kb-mobile{
  .kb-mobile-panel{
    .panel-heading{
      padding-left:0px !important;
      .panel-title{
        font-size:20px !important; 
      }
    }
    .kb-item-block{
      box-shadow: $kb-item-box-shadow;
      padding:15px;
      margin-bottom:10px;
      margin-top: 15px;
      border-radius: 7px;
    }
  }
}
.kb-list-block.has-icon {
  .kb-list-item {
    .kb-list-row {
      overflow: hidden;
      clear: both;
    }
    .kb-list-col-icon {
      float: left;
      width : 30px;
      padding-top: 3px;
      .fa {
        width: 30px;
        font-size: 20px;
        vertical-align: middle;
        color: $brand-primary;
        float: left;
      }
    }
    .kb-list-col-content {
      float: left;
      width: calc(100% - 30px);
    }
  }
}
.kb-rating-stars [role="slider"]:focus{
   box-shadow:none !important;
   outline:none !important;
   border:none !important;
}</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>false</has_preview><id>kb-list-widget-template</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function(scope) {	
	var c = scope.c;
	
	c.openArticleAttachment = function(url, name,  external) {
		if(external) {
			var params = 'toolbar=no,menubar=no,personalbar=no,height='+screen.height + ',' + 'width='+screen.width + ',' + 'scrollbars=yes,resizable=yes,fullscreen=yes';
			window.open(url, name, params);
		}
		else
			window.open(url, name, "toolbar=no,menubar=no,personalbar=no,width=800,height=600,scrollbars=yes,resizable=yes");
	};
	
	c.roundOff = function(val){
		if(val)
			return Math.round(val);
		else
			return 0;
	};
}]]></link><name>Knowledge List Widget Template</name><option_schema>[{"name":"override_mobile","section":"other","default_value":"true","label":"Override Mobile","type":"boolean"}]</option_schema><public>true</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {
	/* populate the 'data' object */
	/* e.g., data.table = $sp.getValue('table'); */
	data.useDocumentViewer = (gs.getProperty('sn_km_portal.glide.knowman.serviceportal.use_document_viewer', 'false') == 'true') && GlidePluginManager.isActive('com.snc.documentviewer');
	data.externalContentLabel = gs.getMessage(gs.getProperty('sn_km_intg.glide.knowman.external.ui_label_for_external_content', 'External Content')) || gs.getMessage('External Content');
	options.kb_rating_style = options.kb_rating_style ? options.kb_rating_style == "true" : true;
	options.show_secondary_information = options.show_secondary_information != null ? options.show_secondary_information : true;
	var viewPageId = $sp.getParameter("id");
	data.isKBView= (viewPageId == "kb_article_view" || viewPageId == "kb_article");
	
})();]]></script><servicenow>true</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2017-01-30 07:36:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>1e6b5b3adb20320099f93691f0b8f5a8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>61</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Knowledge List Widget Template</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Knowledge Management - Service Portal" source="sn_km_portal">bab6dea3db20320099f93691f0b8f590</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Knowledge Management - Service Portal">bab6dea3db20320099f93691f0b8f590</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_1e6b5b3adb20320099f93691f0b8f5a8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2024-01-10 04:58:06</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="kb-list-block" ng-if="c.options.always_show || c.options.result.length" ng-class="{'has-icon' : c.options.glyph, 'kb-mobile' : c.isNative, 'kb-desktop' : !c.isNative}">
  <div ng-class="c.isNative ? 'kb-mobile-panel' : 'panel panel-{{::c.options.color}} b'">
    <div class="panel-heading" ng-class="{'b-b': !c.options.color}"> 
      <h2 ng-if="c.data.isKBView" class="panel-title" ng-bind="::options.title" aria-label="{{options.aria_label_title}}">
      <fa ng-if="::options.glyph" name="{{::options.glyph}}" class="m-r-sm" /></h2>
      <h3 ng-if="!c.data.isKBView" class="panel-title" ng-bind="::options.title" aria-label="{{options.aria_label_title}}">
      <fa ng-if="::options.glyph" name="{{::options.glyph}}" class="m-r-sm" /></h3>
    </div>
    <div ng-if="c.options.result.length > 0" class="list-group hide-x-overflow" style="max-height: {{::c.options.panel_body_height || 'none'}}; overflow-y: auto;" role="list" aria-label="{{options.aria_label_title}}">
      <div ng-repeat="item in c.getOrderedItems() track by item.id" class="list-group-item kb-list-item" ng-class="{'kb-item-block':c.isNative}" role="listitem">
        <div class="kb-list-row">
          <div class="kb-list-col-icon" ng-if="::c.options.glyph">
            <i class="fa fa-{{::c.options.glyph}}" aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </div>
          <div class="kb-list-col-content">
            <div class="main_text" >
              <a tabindex="0" ng-attr-target="{{((item.direct === true && c.data.useDocumentViewer == true) || item.external_link) ? item.id : ''}}" ng-href="{{((item.direct === true && c.data.useDocumentViewer == true) || item.external_link) ? (item.external_link || (item.link + '&view=true')) : item.link}}">
                <div ng-switch on="::item.display_field.type" ng-class="{'l-h-40': !item.secondary_fields.length}">
                  <span class="translated-html" ng-switch-when="translated_html" ng-bind-html="::item.display_field"></span>
                  <div ng-switch-default ng-bind="::item.display_field"></div>
                </div>
              </a>
            </div>
            <small>
              <div class="secondary-info" ng-if="c.options.show_secondary_information">
                <span class="about-outer-span">
                  <span class="sr-only">${Article Metadata}</span>
                  <span ng-repeat="f in item.secondary_fields track by $index">                 
                    <span ng-if="f.value || f.name == 'rating'">
                      <span ng-switch="f.name" class="art-label">
                        <span ng-switch-when="rating">
                          <span ng-if="!$first" class="dot" aria-hidden="true"> • </span>
                          <span class="no-wrap" disabled="true" ng-init="ratingVal =c.roundOff(f.value)">
                            <span class="kb-rating-stars" ng-if="::c.KBRatingStyle">
                              <span class="sr-only">${Article has rating - {{c.roundOff(f.value)}} out of 5 stars}</span>
                              <uib-rating ng-model="ratingVal" max="5" readonly="true" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"/>
                            </span>
                            <span class="sp-stars" ng-if="!c.KBRatingStyle">
                              <span class="sr-only">${Article has rating - {{c.roundOff(f.value)}} out of 5 stars}</span>
                              <span uib-rating sp-rating ng-model="::ratingVal" max="5" readonly="true" aria-hidden="true" state-on="'fa fa-star kb-star-on'" state-off="'fa fa-star kb-star-off'" tabindex="-1"/>
                            </span>
                          </span>
                        </span>
                        <span ng-switch-when="sys_view_count">
                          <span ng-if="!$first" class="dot" aria-hidden="true"> • </span>
                          <span ng-if ="::f.value == '1' " class="no-warp">
                            <span aria-hidden="true" dir="auto">{{::f.value}} ${View}</span>
                            <span class="no-warp sr-only">${Article has {{::f.value}} view}</span>
                          </span>
                          <span ng-if ="::f.value != '1' " class="no-warp">
                            <span aria-hidden="true" dir="auto">{{::f.value}} ${Views}</span>
                          	<span class="sr-only">${Article has {{::f.value}} views}</span>
                          </span>
                        </span>
                        <span ng-switch-when="workflow_state">                        
                          <span ng-if="!$first" class="dot" aria-hidden="true"> • </span><span class="no-warp" aria-hidden="true"><span ng-bind="::f.display_value"></span> ${State}</span>
                          <span class="sr-only">${Article is in {{::f.display_value}} state}</span>
                        </span>
                        <span ng-switch-when="external">                        
                          <span ng-if="f.value == 'true'">
                            <span ng-if="!$first" class="dot" aria-hidden="true"> • </span><span ng-bind="::c.data.externalContentLabel"></span>
                          </span>
                        </span>
                        <span ng-switch-default="" ng-switch="f.type">
                          <span ng-if="!$first" class="dot" aria-hidden="true"> • </span>
                          <span class="no-warp">
                            <span class="secondary-label" ng-if="c.options.show_secondary_fields_label">{{::f.label}}: </span>
                            <span ng-switch-when="glide_date">
                              <span class="sr-only">${Updated}</span>
                              <sn-time-ago timestamp="::f.value"/>
                            </span>
                            <span ng-switch-when="glide_date_time">
                              <span class="sr-only">${Updated}</span>
                              <sn-time-ago timestamp="::f.value" />
                            </span>
                            <span ng-switch-default="" ng-bind="::f.display_value" aria-hidden="{{f.label == 'Author'}}"></span>
                            <span class="sr-only" ng-if="f.label == 'Author' && f.display_value">${Authored by {{::f.display_value}}}</span>
                          </span>
                        </span>
                      </span>
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </span>
              </div>
            </small>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>       
    </div>
    <div ng-if="!c.options.result.length" class="list-group-item" style="border:none">
      ${No content to display}
    </div>
  </div>
</div>]]></template></sp_widget></payload><sys_class_name>sp_rel_widget_clone</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-06-12 12:24:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>c18e895ec3c2e2509d5afeac05013169</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>818e895ec3c2e2509d5afeac05013166</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Easy to get" source="x_1770592_easy_t_0">73143024c37522109d5afeac0501313f</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Easy to get">73143024c37522109d5afeac0501313f</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_rel_widget_clone_c18e895ec3c2e2509d5afeac05013169</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-06-12 12:24:56</sys_updated_on></sp_rel_widget_clone></record_update>
